Samira Khan: Hey everyone! I'm Samira, starting today as an infra SWE. Based in NYC, huge sourdough nerd and plant person. Quick Qs: where do folks get plants around the office, anyone up for lunch at 12:30, and what's the guest WiFi?

Nico (People Ops): Welcome Samira!! 🎉 Lunch sounds great — meet in the kitchen at 12:30. Guest WiFi is `Redwood-Guest`, password `welcome2026!`. I added you to the NYC on-site calendar and the onboarding cohort. Ping me if your keycard isn't working.

Juno: welcome!! :tada: Slack should be good but DM me if anything missing. I'll bring oat milk for coffee at 12:30.

Rafael: hey Samira, welcome to the team — if you want plant cuttings I have succulents to spare. Also if you want a standing desk we can put in a request, or file one at `#eng-infra`.

Daisy: mini poll: coffee ☕ or tea 🍵? reply with "coffee" or "tea" so we can coordinate the meetup.

Samira Khan: coffee for me! thanks for the WiFi info, Nico. Where's the best place to buy a bigger plant nearby?

Juno: There's a plant shop on 5th and Market (GreenThumb) that's great. They do small office deliveries too.

Nico (People Ops): Ordered swag for you — hoodie + stickers. Also I'll drop off a little welcome plant at your desk later today.

welcome-bot: Welcome Samira! You've been added to #new-hires and the "Spring 2026" onboarding channel. See the onboarding checklist in pinned messages.

Daisy: tea squad reporting in 😅 but will bring a tea option too.

Rafael: I'll leave a cutting on your desk after lunch. See you at 12:30!

Samira Khan: You all are the best, thanks for the warm welcome — excited to dig in :)
